prior_polish_notes: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility, one short-lived OmniLight3D. Modes one/two share geometry, colors and timing; the shadow flag is the intended difference.
Rules, encounter JSON and EngineSession remain unchanged. The visual preview calls no battle action and consumes no movement, HP, host time or settlement.
No LightmapGI, SSAO, native depth of field, volumetric fog or renderer change in this experiment.
Visual resemblance and Web performance require actual observation; no equivalence to the commercial games is claimed.

Environmental/combat lighting controls are disabled throughout preview and actual action playback so a temporary light cannot overwrite a newly selected profile. They unlock after exact baseline restoration.

Final tuning: Cube positional shadows replace the rejected DualParaboloid grid artifact. Global Glow remains disabled and exposure multipliers remain 1.0 after the rejected washed-out draft; local unshaded sword ribbons provide the visible arc. The preview alone zooms to 0.78 of the normal orthographic size, identically in all three modes, then restores it.

Original slash fan is retained for mode zero and enemy attacks; illuminated friendly sword attacks use one gold/white ribbon instead of duplicate fans. Name text is limited to idle selected/hovered actors; compact HP bars remain visible.
